text:
Carla G: FYI we're trying to finalize what runtime/infra needs to feed the new per-route dashboards (latency P50/P95, tokens-in, tokens-out, reqid/spans availability). Need a quick handshake on fields + sampling policy.

Ben K: Can you list the concrete fields you want in the metrics ingest? Easier to align that way.

Carla G: Sure — minimal set: route, model_variant, region, gantt/span_present(true/false), req_id (x-redwood-reqid), parent_span_id (if any), sample_flag, token_count_in, token_count_out, latency_ms. For large traffic routes we expect sampling.

Alice M: For the console, we also need a stable request-key to join logs -> traces (can't use ephemeral spans). req_id should be 64-bit hex and present on all downstream calls. Agree on header name: `x-rwd-reqid`?

Sam I: infra is already emitting `x-request-id` at LB layer. Mixing header names will be messy. We can map `x-rwd-reqid` -> `x-request-id` at ingress if we pick `x-rwd-reqid` as canonical.

Maria D: UX ask: dashboards show sampled vs total counts. Need `sample_rate` and `sample_bucket` (e.g., deterministic buckets) so we can estimate totals. Also retention note: traces are 30d, metrics 90d.

Carla G: Good call. So include `sample_rate` (0-1 string) and `sample_key` for deterministic sampling. Also include `sample_policy` tag (`always`, `probabilistic`, `head` for head-based).

Ben K: Runtime change: we can flip a flag to include `req_id` and top-level span in our access logs. For sampled traces we'll push spans to jaeger; for unsampled we still include span_present=false and the req_id.

runtime-oncall: Heads-up — when you change log format, please coordinate rolling deploy with oncall. Log schema changes broke our alert parsers last time.

Carla G: Noted. Plan: runtime PR adds header propagation + log fields behind feature flag `feat/trace-prop-v2`. We'll do a canary on dedicated pool A for 4 hours then scale.

Ben K: Implementation detail: header propagation in runtime is two-fold: 1) accept incoming `x-rwd-reqid` or generate one if missing; 2) attach `x-rwd-reqid` to all downstream HTTP/gRPC calls and to requests queued for worker GPUs. I'll add code like:```python
# pseudo
req_id = req.headers.get('x-rwd-reqid') or generate_reqid()
req.context['req_id'] = req_id
outgoing.headers['x-rwd-reqid'] = req_id
```

Sam I: For LB mapping we'll add a transform that maps existing `x-request-id` -> `x-rwd-reqid` for internal calls. We need to update our Nginx config and kube ingress annotation. I'll open infra ticket.

Maria D: On sampling: runtime should mark `sample_flag` true if the request's span gets exported. Also set `sample_policy` and `sample_key`. For deterministic sampling we use `hash(req_id) % 1000 < N`. If we emit `sample_key` as the hash bucket it helps rollups.

Ben K: Good. We'll also emit `parent_span_id` when present. For generated root spans we set `parent_span_id`="-". In access logs we will emit a JSON blob field `trace_meta` with `{req_id, span_id, parent_span_id, sampled}`. Keep it small.

Carla G: Console ingestion (metrics pipeline) wants separate kafka topics: `metrics.route-summaries` and `telemetry.traces-meta` (for the small JSON blobs). Can infra/streaming owners confirm retention & throughput?

Sam I: Kafka team: retention default 7d, but we can bump `telemetry.traces-meta` to 30d if needed. Throughput: estimated 200k msgs/s peak across clusters. We need schema registry entries.

Alice M: On console side we'll need derived fields: tokens-per-request, avg-latency-per-token, and a join on req_id to show trace link CTA. Suggest `trace_link` URL template `https://jaeger.redwood.svc/trace/{span_id}` and we can show it when `sampled=true`.

Maria D: UX detail: if sampled=false still show "View logs" linked by req_id. But show a disabled "View trace" with tooltip "trace not sampled".

Carla G: Rollout plan: 1) feature flag green path that emits fields to logs & kafka but doesn't change header mapping. 2) infra mapping enabled in second phase. 3) canaries + onboarding doc for teams. 4) postmortem to confirm no alert breakages.

Ben K: API debate: Should platform accept both `x-rwd-reqid` and `x-request-id` in the public API? I vote no — public API accepts multiple header names for compatibility, but all internal services canonicalize to `x-rwd-reqid` at ingress.

Sam I: Agreed. We'll do mapping and publish header contract in API docs + SDKs.

runtime-oncall: Please include a rollout toggle that allows disabling `trace_meta` emission per-route in case we hit noisy routes. Also rate-limit the meta messages to kafka to avoid bursts.

Ben K: We'll add `emit_trace_meta` route config and a token-bucket limiter in the telemetry client.

Carla G: Action items: Ben - PR for runtime instrumentation + feature flag; Sam - infra ticket for header mapping + kafka topic + retention; Maria - console schema + UX for sampled vs unsampled; Alice - docs + SDK header mapping guidance; runtime-oncall - define emergency rollback steps. I'll create a tracking board and a short ops runbook.

Ben K: I'll tag the PR `feat/trace-ingest-handshake` and ping here when ready.

Sam I: Ticket created INFRA-9876 with Nginx mapping, Kafka topic requests, and schema registry entry.

deploy-bot: deploy started for `runtime-service` tag `feat/trace-prop-v2` in cluster `canary-A` (id: dpl-7812) :rocket:

Carla G: Thanks all — let's sync tomorrow 10am for final signoffs. :thumbsup:
